Time for different time zones

Product·by @tar_uniqueee·2026-09-03·inspora page·original post

What it is

Dark world-clock app with a scrubbable 24h tick ruler: dragging shifts time globally, all city rows roll odometer clocks, an orange band shows the scrubbed window with live duration, statuses (night/working) update; rows can be drag-reordered.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-12%
Resting: tick ruler with red NOW marker; 4 city rows (Warsaw, SF -9H, NY -6H, New Delhi +3H30M) with day label, status icon, HH:MM.
12-30%
Drag: ticks stream horizontally; orange band grows right of NOW labeled '-1H 15M'; row times roll like odometers; statuses flip.
30-55%
Band widens to '-6H 40M'..'-7H'; day labels flip to YESTERDAY for cities crossing midnight.
55-75%
Band settles ~-9H; final scrubbed times and updated status icons.
75-92%
Release: ruler springs back to NOW, band collapses; times roll back up; statuses revert.
92-100%
Resting state restored. One frame shows New Delhi dragged above New York - row reorder gesture.

Mechanics

trigger
horizontal drag on ruler; vertical drag to reorder rows
elements
tick ruler canvas, NOW marker, selection band + duration label, city rows (name, offset badge, day chip, status icon, rolling time)
properties
ruler translateX, band width, digit odometer translateY, row translateY reorder
timing
1:1 scrub; release spring-back ~500ms; digit rolls ~200ms
easing
spring (stiffness ~170, damping ~22) release; linear scrub
loop
demo loops scrub-out + snap-back

Build prompt

Build a timezone scrubber. Header: 24-hour tick ruler (canvas: 1px bars per 10min, taller at hours) under a fixed red NOW line. Horizontal drag maps px->minutes (~4px=10min) into a global timeOffset. While offset != 0, fill an orange band from NOW to the scrubbed position with a centered duration label ('-6H 40M'). City rows (name, GMT badge, TODAY/YESTERDAY chip, status icon, time) render liveTime + zoneOffset + timeOffset. Times = per-digit odometer columns: each digit a translateY strip rolling 200ms ease, only changed digits roll. Status icons from local hour (moon 22-06, green dot 9-18, else sun). On release, animate timeOffset->0 with a spring (stiffness ~170, damping ~22) so ruler, band and digits roll back together. Rows support vertical drag-reorder with translateY following the finger and siblings animating aside.
